events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Festival of Music & Art took place in Bethel, New York, in 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibes
angles.copy: Imagine a weekend of peace, love, and three days of music that defined a generation. 57 years ago, Woodstock made history.

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: This marks the anniversary of the passing of Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll'.

angles.name: King's Legacy
angles.copy: 49 years ago today, the music world lost its King. Elvis Presley's iconic sound continues to shake, rattle, and roll us.

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: We mark the anniversary of the tragic passing of influential rapper Tupac Shakur in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac's Impact
angles.copy: 30 years on, Tupac Shakur's lyrics and legacy still resonate. His influence on music and culture remains undeniable.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: This day marks the anniversary of the death of guitar legend Jimi Hendrix.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: 56 years ago, we lost a true innovator. Jimi Hendrix redefined what a guitar could do, and his sound lives on.

events.title: Abbey Road Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album in 1969.

angles.name: Across the Abbey Road
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still one of the most famous walks in music history.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still delivering those Pretenders classics with pure rock 'n' roll attitude.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Mad for it!
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still rocking the stage and keeping it absolutely biblical.

events.title: 'Imagine' Single Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic single 'Imagine' in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: 51 years ago, John Lennon gave the world a song to dream to. 'Imagine' remains a powerful message for unity and peace.

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first generation iPod in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Tunes
angles.copy: Remember when your entire music library fit in your pocket? 25 years ago, the original iPod changed everything.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: A global celebration of the James Bond film franchise, marking the release date of the first film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes, what's your favourite 007 moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: We remember John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're celebrating the enduring genius of John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: And Now For Something Completely Different
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedy genius, John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty, always brilliant.

events.title: 'The White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', in 1968.

angles.name: Revolutionary Album
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling, diverse masterpiece that still sounds fresh today.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: This day marks the anniversary of the passing of the iconic Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: The Show Must Go On
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched, a true legend.
